tool_config.name: get_shift_briefing
tool_config.description: Get this clinician's synthetic shift briefing: the urgent item, the primary case, other patients, consults and the timeline. Call this first on every call and speak only what it returns.

tool_config.name: email_front_desk
tool_config.description: Send the clinician's message to the hospital front desk, for example that they are running late or have an emergency. The server holds the address and writes the email: you supply only the reason and the words. Read the message back and get a clear yes before calling this.

reason.description: Why the message is being sent.

message.description: What to tell the front desk, in the clinician's own words. One or two sentences.

etaMinutes.description: Minutes until the clinician expects to arrive, when they gave a number.

confirmed.description: True only after you read the message back and the clinician agreed to send it.

tool_config.name: get_topics
tool_config.description: List the learning topics that have a round behind them. Call this before offering or discussing a quiz, and never offer a topic marked unavailable.

tool_config.name: get_round_context
tool_config.description: Get the authoritative round, its sources, the synthetic case and this learner's saved checkpoint. Call this first and use the returned bundle instead of model memory.

tool_config.name: submit_answer
tool_config.description: Send the learner's spoken answer to the server for grading. The server owns the answer key: never grade the answer yourself. A duplicate submission returns the grade already recorded.

answer.description: The learner's actual final answer, in their own words. Pass an option letter only when they clearly said one.

tool_config.name: complete_round
tool_config.description: Complete the round after the answer has been graded and the learner's question is finished. Only the server awards XP and sets the next review. Calling it twice does not award anything again.

tool_config.name: get_context_summary
tool_config.description: Read the requested active synthetic scenario section for this signed call. Never infer missing facts; use the returned fallback.
